sloka: व्यथयन् राक्षसान् सर्वान् हर्षयंश्चापि वानरान् ।स वानराणां मध्ये तु रामपार्श्वमुपागतः ।। ६.४१.९० ।।।।
transliteration: vyathayan rākṣasān sarvān harṣayaṁścāpi vānarān ।sa vānarāṇāṁ madhye tu rāmapārśvamupāgataḥ ।। 6.41.90 ।।।।

translations.english: As Ravana was looking, Angada trampling his feet gave way to the palace just as Himalayan peak broke to hit Indra.
